entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Jāmeh Mosque of Sari is a Shi'ite Friday mosque (Jāmeh), located in Sari, in the district of Chinarban, in the province of Mazandaran, Iran. The current Qajar era structure is devoid of any historical relics. It has a square sahn, nocturnal areas and a porch.
